iac-end-plug.summary: The illustrative end plug has a recessed flange captured between a body lip and shoulder.

steps.title: Keep the spring reference
steps.text: Its inner face remains at the original spring seat. Continuous modeled contact closes the geometric gap; this does not prove vacuum sealing or production fit.

steps.title: Retention is a chosen construction
steps.text: The exact1994 picture shows a circular closure/rim but does not establish pressed, crimped or threaded retention. The integral formed lip is an educational choice.

troubleshooting.title: A loose closure loses both references
troubleshooting.text: The fault control opens a connected geometric channel and loses spring-seat contact. It is a topology demonstration, not a leak-rate or service procedure.

iac-end-plug.limits: Illustrative captured metal closure, not an identified Ford construction. Exact valve variant, retention/fit, material, forming process, contact pressure, strength and leak-rate remain unknown. The old0.1mm geometric gap has been superseded; no separate seal or factory interference is inferred.

iac-valve-body.summary: The valve retains its two-port attachment and adds an illustrative recessed closure seat.

steps.title: Local adaptation only
steps.text: The closure recess removes15.569733mm³ from the attachment candidate. Mounting flange, gasket passages, chambers and pintle seat remain unchanged.

steps.title: Retain the flange
steps.text: Both axial faces of the plug flange contact the body. Straight withdrawal is blocked by the assembled lip; its real forming process and service removal are not simulated.
